_doc: Per-host secrets for the decommissioned RC<->Peer cross-Claude bridge (ADR-012). Copy this file to ops/local_paths.json (gitignored) and fill in the real values. Empty values disable the bridge - RC's /api/bridge/inbox returns 503 and outbound bridge.send() returns (False, 'bridge_not_configured').
_secret_note: A long random string, identical on both RC and Peer. Generate with: python -c "import secrets; print(secrets.token_urlsafe(32))". Treat as a credential - never commit, never log, never paste into chat.
_url_note: Base URL of the peer (no trailing slash). Same-host today: e.g. https://127.0.0.1:8888 for Peer, https://127.0.0.1:8888 for RC if both bind loopback. Cross-host later: routable hostname/IP. The peer must be serving /api/bridge/inbox at this base URL.
